cases.name: constraints: a process and a loan that break every rule written in GQL
blocks: (t_transition:ElementType {id: 'type:TRANSITION', name: 'TRANSITION', kind: 'edge', reading: 'goes to', reverse_name: 'comes from'}),

constraints.why: a final state has no way out
constraints.gql: MATCH (s:State)-[:TRANSITION]->(t) WHERE s.final = TRUE RETURN [[s.id, 'final']] AS slots, [{from: s.id, type: 'TRANSITION', to: t.id}] AS edges

constraints.why: a repayment is never dated before its loan was drawn down
constraints.gql: MATCH (r:Repayment)-[:REPAYS]->(l:Loan) WHERE r.at < l.drawn_at RETURN [[r.id, 'at'], [l.id, 'drawn_at']] AS slots

constraints.why: a flow has one start state
constraints.gql: MATCH (s:State) WHERE s.initial = TRUE WITH s.flow AS f, collect(s.id) AS xs WHERE size(xs) > 1 RETURN [x IN xs | [x, 'initial']] AS slots
